report.summary: No blocking issues. All four branch-tip lookups (PR create/reopen, merge preparation, startCiRun, push/adoption head checks) now pass the plain branch name to the binding's log(). The test fakes no longer strip refs/heads/, so the tests would catch this bug again. The forge demo patterns match both Node 24's 'ℹ fail 0' and TAP's '# fail 0'. No spec change is needed.

findings.text: validateArtifactRef accepts refs that start with 'refs/heads/', and the repository browser passes them unchanged to repo.log (handlers/repositories.ts:252 and :338). If the binding returns no commits for full ref names, as this PR says, browsing 'refs/heads/main' shows nothing. This was there before the PR; consider a follow-up that strips the prefix or rejects these refs.

log() with a plain name also resolves tags, so a tag with the same name as a branch could be picked instead of the branch tip. This is a small edge case; consider adding a note to docs/IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md.
